name: NovaStar Kompass Media Server

actions.name: program
actions.description: Selects and plays the program slot: stores the id as instance.programId and sends control tag 366 (4 byte value). The pause/play/stop actions below reuse the stored id.

options.description: Source option name: 'Program' (written as name:, not label:).

actions.name: pause_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 133 with the last selected program id (instance.programId; undefined until the program action ran).

actions.name: play_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 271 with the last selected program id (instance.programId; undefined until the program action ran).

actions.name: stop_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 272 with the last selected program id (instance.programId; undefined until the program action ran).

actions.name: open_ftb
actions.description: Sends control tag 260.

actions.name: close_ftb
actions.description: Sends control tag 261.

actions.name: open_volume
actions.description: Sends control tag 262.

actions.name: close_volume
actions.description: Sends control tag 263.

actions.name: ppt_pgup
actions.description: Sends control tag 286 (data length 36, value 0).

actions.name: ppt_pgdn
actions.description: Sends control tag 287 (data length 64, value 0).

actions.name: volume_up
actions.description: Sends control tag 328 with the fixed step 5 (VOLUME_STEP).

actions.name: volume_down
actions.description: Sends control tag 329 with the fixed step 5 (VOLUME_STEP).

actions.name: brightness_up
actions.description: Sends control tag 391 with bytes [0x01, 2] (BRIGHTNESS_STEP 2; the source comment says step 5).

actions.name: brightness_down
actions.description: Sends control tag 391 with bytes [0x00, 2] (BRIGHTNESS_STEP 2; the source comment says step 5).

actions.name: play
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with value 0.

actions.name: pause
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with value 1.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Sends control tag 387 with value 2.

actions.name: open_test_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 258.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: close_test_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 259.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: previous_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 388 with value 0.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: next_program
actions.description: Sends control tag 388 with value 1.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: bind_media
actions.description: Sends control tag 10004 with the program and layer index as two little-endian 16-bit values. The action also has subscribe/unsubscribe handlers that remember program and layer per button for the bind_media feedback.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: bind_cue_tag
actions.description: Sends control tag 10005 with the cue index.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: score_up
actions.description: Adds to the score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media); control tag 10039, type 0x01. The step field has the tooltip 'Amount to increase the score by each time'.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: score_down
actions.description: Subtracts from the score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media); control tag 10039, type 0xFF. The step field has the tooltip 'Amount to decrease the score by each time'.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: score_reset
actions.description: Resets the main score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media); control tag 10041.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: score_undo
actions.description: Undoes the last step on the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media); control tag 10042.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: score_set
actions.description: Sets the main score of the currently selected scoreboard media (select it first with select_media); control tag 10040, value clamped to 0-999. The field also sets clampValues: true (tooltip 'Target score (0-999)').
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

actions.name: select_media
actions.description: Selects a media by program and layer (control tag 10038, program in the low 4 bytes, layer in the high 4 bytes). The action also has subscribe/unsubscribe handlers that remember program and layer per button for the selected_media feedback.
actions.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES in utils/constant.js, getAllActions).

feedbacks.name: Selected Media
feedbacks.description: Show this button's Select Media action program and layer. Sets the button text to 'Select Media\n(<program>-<layer>)' when the button has a select_media action; otherwise returns an empty style.
feedbacks.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro; for other models no feedbacks are registered.

feedbacks.name: Bind Media
feedbacks.description: Show this button's Bind Media action program and layer. Sets the button text to 'Bind Media\n(<program>-<layer>)' when the button has a bind_media action; otherwise returns an empty style.
feedbacks.availability: Only registered when the configured modelId is fx3pro; for other models no feedbacks are registered.

notes: Complete list of the active definitions: 29 action ids (17 from getActions in src/actions.js, 12 more from getAllActions) and 2 advanced feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js). Commented-out blocks in src/actions.js (update_program, set_volume, open_layer_volume, close_layer_volume, refresh, take_program, cut_program) are not registered and not catalogued.

Models (utils/constant.js): fx3pro (Kompass FX3 Pro) and rx6 (Kompass RX6). Only fx3pro gets the 12 extra actions and the 2 feedbacks (ADD_ACTIONS_DEVICES); rx6 gets the 17 base actions and no feedbacks. The modelId field defaults to the first product, fx3pro.

Protocol: binary control packets (tag, data length, data) over UDP to the configured host, port 18960 by default (config field 'port', default '18960'), local bind 0.0.0.0:18961 (src/main.js:54-57). The host default in the source is a private example address and is not recorded.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.15.1 (1.x): options do not support expressions.

Dropdown id types as written: program ids are numbers 0-255 with number default 0, layer ids are strings '0'-'49' with string default '0'. bind_media and select_media have subscribe/unsubscribe handlers (button-local state for the feedbacks).
Option labels of the program action are written as 'name:' in the source (not a valid option field), so that option carries no label.
The score_* actions act on the media chosen last with select_media; the source does not check that a scoreboard media is selected.
Nothing in this file was tested against a device.
